description: Historical feature construction generated a game and immediately applied its final result before generating later games on the same officialDate. Any validation produced by that chronology is non-deployment evidence regardless of pass/fail outcome. Cutoff-correct reruns must freeze prior-day state for all same-date games and apply results only after the date batch is fully featurized.

Cutoff-correct chronology tests passed, but validation artifacts contained schedule exclusions with officialDate values outside the declared requested/holdout interval. The loaders trusted response/cache contents after request construction instead of enforcing start <= officialDate <= end on every row. Because complete out-of-range Final rows could therefore enter year-based model splits, these runs are non-deployment evidence regardless of their market pass/fail results. Source-bounded successors must reject every out-of-request row before feature construction.
